video_title: Kennedy Chandler Media Day 2026 Press Availability

quotes.speaker: Kennedy Chandler
quotes.text: Just them giving me opportunity. I know there was only like 10 games that had left in the season, so I just wanted to go out there in the court and play the best I can and show the teams what I could do and they gave me that opportunity and I feel like I came in each and every single game and played my best and that was my whole mindset going to with them.
quotes.pull_quote: I just wanted to go out there in the court and play the best I can
quotes.news_angle: Kennedy Chandler discusses his mindset during his final games with the Utah Jazz.
quotes.social_post: Kennedy Chandler reflects on his time with the Utah Jazz, saying he just wanted to go out there in the court and play the best I can to show teams what he could do.

quotes.speaker: Kennedy Chandler
quotes.text: Ever since I have been here it has been good vibes. The chemistry with the team, the coaches, the players, everyone, it is like a family. So, it is going in and everyone is competing hard. That is the main thing that I have learned since I have been here honestly. So just coming in and get ready for training camp and getting after it and getting ready for these preseason games. I want them to see like them last 10 games that I had with Utah wasn't just a surprise. That is who I am and I want to show them that here as well coming up training camp and preseason.
quotes.pull_quote: I want them to see like them last 10 games that I had with Utah wasn't just a surprise.
quotes.news_angle: Kennedy Chandler aims to prove his late-season performance with Utah was not a fluke.
quotes.social_post: Kennedy Chandler says he wants to show the Phoenix Suns that his performance in the final 10 games with Utah was not just a surprise, but a reflection of who he is as a player.
